portada.intro: I build the live systems a game runs on once it's public: economy, gacha, purchases, progression and save data, and I take them from spec to release. Publishing my own titles since 2019 and building client work on Roblox, UEFN and Unity since 2022, usually as part of a small team. Co-founder of Dragonark Studios.

bloques.texto: An agentic bot on a local large language model, plus retrieval-augmented generation flows running in production on the OpenAI API: document retrieval and prompt design.

CI/CD pipelines on GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build with continuous deployment. Serverless backends on Firebase Cloud Functions and AWS Lambda: REST endpoints, server-side validation and idempotent writes. Web hardening with CSP, HSTS and COOP.

proyectos.tipo: Live on Roblox · Sunset Games Studio · 2026
parrafos: I built a full live-ops layer for a football card-collecting game: coin economy with sources and sinks analytics, pack gacha with pity counters, in-game purchases with receipt idempotency, album pass, daily rewards, idle and offline income with AFK caps, cosmetics, badges and referrals, plus a multi-phase onboarding tutorial with funnel metrics.

proyectos.tipo: UEFN · worldwide brand event for Trident (Mondelez)
parrafos: I built a custom Fortnite island with four interconnected minigames: a time-trial race, an escape room, parkour challenges and a final boss battle against a mad scientist and his minions, tying mechanics and progression to the narrative goal of recovering the Formula X.
I ran the full development and level design for a worldwide event.

proyectos.tipo: Multi-platform XR ecosystem · sustainable housing · with Ecopetrol & UPB
parrafos: I built several interconnected experiences around one sustainable house of the future: five web augmented reality apps opened from a QR code with no app download, two VR applications (a 1:1 replica of the house and a guided meditation), an interactive mobile web journey whose minigames explained how the ecovilla works, a promotional film built in Unreal Engine, and a tablet app with 3D visualization and real-time effects.
I also built its AI assistant, running both on the device and on the OpenAI API, to answer visitors' questions.

proyectos.tipo: VRChat · virtual venue for Visa events and product launches
parrafos: An immersive virtual space for Visa to host live events: I optimized the 3D assets and scene performance and refined the interactive systems so the venue stayed stable and smooth with an audience inside it.
Children coloured a paper bear, placed it into a playful “oven” installation, and watched their own drawing come alive in a shared virtual world on a big screen.

I built the systems connecting the physical interaction to the real-time digital result, making sure the translation was faithful and the whole thing stayed stable in front of a live audience of small children.

proyectos.tipo: Own game · Android & Steam · Top 6 at Global Game Jam UPB Medellín
parrafos: I owned the gameplay systems, progression and difficulty balance for Bubble Hero, a wave-survival game we took from a 48-hour Global Game Jam build to a public release on Google Play and Steam.
A bullet heaven action game for the MapleStory Worlds platform: the player travels across different eras, dodges waves of enemies and levels up their skills with artifacts to restore the timeline.
We developed it at Dragonark Studios as part of Nexon America's MapleStory Worlds Creators' Workshop, a selective 12-week program, and it was released in December 2025.
Before Dragonark I self-published two commercial Android titles, SodaRocket Challenge (2019) and Myth Pets (2020), handling design, development and store release on my own.
